title: Aegis self-heal event
x_note: Output of tools/self_heal.py heal() (D-45). One event per recovery attempt, appended to data/eod/<date>/self_heal_<date>.jsonl. Order-blind by construction: no order/size/arm field exists here.

loop.description: the loop/step that failed (premarket, post-market, ptj, ...)

ts.description: UTC timestamp from the environment, never invented

healed.description: true only if a bounded safe fix succeeded

escalate.description: true if the PM must act

stand_down.description: true if a hard gate/tripwire stood the process down (never auto-healed)

actions.description: the recovery actions attempted, each with its own result

manual_fix.description: the /recover-family command the PM can run
